fields.name: invoice_number
fields.description: Unique identifier assigned to the commercial invoice.

fields.name: invoice_date
fields.description: Date on which the commercial invoice was issued.

fields.name: seller
fields.description: Party selling the goods or services.

fields.name: buyer
fields.description: Party purchasing the goods.

fields.name: consignee
fields.description: Party designated to receive the shipped goods.

fields.name: exporter
fields.description: Party exporting the goods from the origin country.

fields.name: shipper
fields.description: Party sending or tendering the goods for transportation.

fields.name: notify_party
fields.description: Party that must be notified regarding shipment arrival or delivery.

fields.name: lc_number
fields.description: Identifier of the letter of credit associated with the transaction.

fields.name: lc_date
fields.description: Date of the letter of credit.

fields.name: bl_number
fields.description: Unique identifier of the bill of lading.

fields.name: purchase_order_number
fields.description: Purchase order identifier associated with the transaction.

fields.name: po_number
fields.description: Purchase order identifier associated with a specific line item.

fields.name: invoice_reference
fields.description: Reference to a related commercial invoice or invoice transaction.

fields.name: document_number
fields.description: General identifier assigned to the document.

fields.name: flight_number
fields.description: Flight identifier used for air transportation.

fields.name: contract_number
fields.description: Identifier of the commercial or transport contract.

fields.name: reference_number
fields.description: General transaction or document reference identifier.

fields.name: booking_number
fields.description: Booking identifier assigned to the shipment by a carrier or forwarder.

fields.name: part_number
fields.description: Part identifier assigned to a line item.

fields.name: sku
fields.description: Stock keeping unit identifier of a line item.

fields.name: document_date
fields.description: General issue or preparation date of the document.

fields.name: currency
fields.description: Currency used for monetary amounts in the invoice.

fields.name: total_amount
fields.description: Final total monetary amount stated on the invoice.

fields.name: payment_terms
fields.description: Conditions defining when and how payment must be made.

fields.name: incoterm
fields.description: International commercial term defining delivery responsibility and risk transfer.

fields.name: vessel
fields.description: Name of the vessel or main transport conveyance.

fields.name: voyage_number
fields.description: Voyage identifier associated with the vessel or shipment.

fields.name: departure_date
fields.description: Date on which the shipment or conveyance departs.

fields.name: shipment_date
fields.description: Date on which the goods were shipped or placed on board.

fields.name: arrival_date
fields.description: Date on which the shipment arrives or is expected to arrive.

fields.name: port_of_loading
fields.description: Port or place where goods are loaded onto the main conveyance.

fields.name: port_of_discharge
fields.description: Port or place where goods are discharged from the main conveyance.

fields.name: place_of_receipt
fields.description: Place where the carrier first receives the goods.

fields.name: place_of_delivery
fields.description: Place where the carrier is required to deliver the goods.

fields.name: final_destination
fields.description: Final destination of the transported goods.

fields.name: container_number
fields.description: Identifier assigned to the freight container.

fields.name: seal_number
fields.description: Identifier of the security seal applied to a container or shipment.

fields.name: package_count
fields.description: Total number of packages in the shipment.

fields.name: package_type
fields.description: Type of packaging used for the shipment.

fields.name: carton_count
fields.description: Total number of cartons.

fields.name: pallet_count
fields.description: Total number of pallets.

fields.name: gross_weight
fields.description: Weight of goods including packaging.

fields.name: net_weight
fields.description: Weight of goods excluding packaging.

fields.name: weight_unit
fields.description: Unit used for weight measurements.

fields.name: measurement
fields.description: Shipment volume or dimensional measurement.

fields.name: cbm
fields.description: Shipment volume expressed in cubic metres.

fields.name: shipment_type
fields.description: Classification or type of shipment.

fields.name: goods_description
fields.description: Description of goods or commodities carried under the bill of lading.

fields.name: description
fields.description: Description of a specific product or line item.

fields.name: hs_code
fields.description: Harmonized System tariff classification code for a line item.

fields.name: quantity
fields.description: Quantity of a specific line item.

fields.name: unit
fields.description: Unit of measure associated with a line item quantity.

fields.name: unit_price
fields.description: Price per individual unit of a line item.

fields.name: amount
fields.description: Extended monetary amount for a line item.

fields.name: line_number
fields.description: Sequential number identifying a row or line item.

fields.name: product_code
fields.description: Product identifier associated with a line item.

fields.name: shipping_mark
fields.description: Marks or numbers used to identify packages or shipped goods.

fields.name: country_of_origin
fields.description: Country where the goods originate or were produced.

fields.name: country_of_destination
fields.description: Country to which the goods are ultimately destined.

fields.name: carrier
fields.description: Transport company or carrier responsible for moving the shipment.

fields.name: bank
fields.description: Bank involved in payment or documentary credit for the transaction.

fields.name: manufacturer
fields.description: Party that manufactured or produced the goods.

fields.name: signatory_company
fields.description: Company represented by the authorized signatory on the document.

fields.name: delivery_terms
fields.description: Contractual conditions governing delivery of the goods.

fields.name: method_of_dispatch
fields.description: Method or mode by which goods are dispatched or transported.

fields.name: freight
fields.description: Freight charge stated separately from the goods value.

fields.name: insurance
fields.description: Insurance charge stated separately from the goods value.

fields.name: tax
fields.description: Tax or VAT amount stated on the invoice.

fields.name: discount
fields.description: Discount amount deducted from the invoice value.

fields.name: subtotal
fields.description: Intermediate total before final charges, discounts, or taxes.

fields.name: other_charges
fields.description: Additional monetary charges not represented by another specific charge field.
